SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m, s.store_id < 900 AS is_store, f.channel_code,
       count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS d_line, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS d_rl,
       sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx,
       min(f.etl_loaded_at) l0, max(f.etl_loaded_at) l1
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-25' AND DATE '2024-10-05'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH l AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m, s.store_id, p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test, f.staff_purchase_flag AS staff,
         f.gross_amount, f.net_amount, f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id < 900
)
SELECT m, is_test, staff, count(*) n, sum(gross_amount) gross, sum(net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT store_id) stores
FROM l GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT date_trunc('month', business_date) m, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (business_date, store_id)) d, count(DISTINCT store_id) stores,
       sum(net_sales_before_returns) nsbr, sum(returns_net) ret, sum(net_sales) ns
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AS from_sep1, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) g, sum(f.net_amount) nt,
       sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.gross_amount IS NULL OR f.net_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nulls
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

       sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.gross_amount IS NULL OR f.net_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_rows
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT d.calendar_year AS year, d.calendar_month AS month, SUM(f.gross_amount) AS store_sales_incl_vat_before_returns
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
